tiers.name: A second pitch beside the first

events.line: It was a proper market day and the whole county turned up.
The cattle mart let out and every farmer in Cumberland came for a bite.
Day trippers from over the border, all very polite and all carrying carrier bags.
The car park flooded and nobody could reach the hall.
A cold snap kept the shoppers at home with the fire on.
The new cheese stall next door sent people over for something sweet.

upgrades.name: A card reader
upgrades.text: Nobody carries cash. The fees are the price of being easy to pay.

upgrades.name: Standing orders from the cafes
upgrades.text: A steady order every week, and a bad week stings less.

upgrades.name: A second market day a week
upgrades.text: More takings, more baking, and no day off.

asks.title: The trader's licence
asks.text: The council has written to {deed}: the trader's licence is up for renewal, and so, in a separate paragraph, are the fees.

options.label: Renew it, pay the fee and be done
options.say: Stamped, filed and valid for another year.

options.label: Renew it on the last day, the form is a nightmare
options.say: You make it with an hour to spare and a sore wrist.

risk.say: Late by one day, which is, as it turns out, a full week.

options.label: Leave it on the pile
options.say: A very polite letter turns into a less polite one. You are closed for a week while it is sorted.
